pages.title: Epsilon Dust
pages.text: For every epsilon there is a delta: grains as small as anyone asks, and smaller. Found in Epsilon Ore in the Continuum (the Platonic Realm, Y 880 to 1040), and dropped by Fourier Wisps. The Analytic Continuator builds Real Continua and Infinitesimals from it.
$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Epsilon Ore$(), in veins through the rock.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Fourier Wisp.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dense Stone, Infinitesimal, Real Continuum.
